about: Mixture classification constants (service 8). Values from CLP Annex I (Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 as amended) and UN GHS Rev.10, Part 3-4; worked examples in ECHA Guidance on the Application of the CLP Criteria (Part 3 v5.0 Nov 2024, Parts 4-5 v4.0 Nov 2024). Read by the browser through the generated safety_rules_data.jsx; the classification itself runs in the browser (mixghs_core.jsx).

acute.basis: CLP Annex I 3.1.3.6 (additivity formula, 3.1.3.6.2.3 correction for unknown ingredients >= 10 %), Table 3.1.1 (category ranges), Table 3.1.2 (converted acute toxicity point estimates), 3.1.3.3(a) relevant ingredients, Table 1.1 generic cut-off 0.1 % for Categories 1-3

skin.basis: CLP Annex I 3.2.3.3.4, Table 3.2.3 (additivity; SCLs replace GCLs: sum of C/limit >= 1)

eye.basis: CLP Annex I 3.3.3.3, Table 3.3.3 (Skin Corr. 1 + Eye Dam. 1 summed for Eye Dam. 1; SCLs replace GCLs)

sens.basis: CLP Annex I Table 3.4.5 (no additivity); EUH208 at 1/10 of the limit (Annex II 2.8)

cmr.basis: CLP Annex I Tables 3.5.2, 3.6.2, 3.7.2 (no additivity across ingredients is applied here)

stot.basis: CLP Annex I Tables 3.8.3 and 3.9.4; 3.8.3.4.5 (Category 3: 20 % summed, respiratory irritation and narcotic effects separately)

asp.basis: CLP Annex I 3.10.3.3.1 (sum >= 10 % and kinematic viscosity <= 20.5 mm2/s at 40 C)

aquatic.basis: CLP Annex I 4.1.3.5.5, Tables 4.1.1 and 4.1.2 (summation with M-factors, Chronic 1-4); relevant ingredients 4.1.3.1 (0.1 % / M for Acute 1 and Chronic 1, 1 % for others)

label.basis: CLP Article 26 (pictogram precedence) and Article 27 (hazard statements: H314 covers H318; Aquatic Acute 1 with Chronic 1 is labelled H410)
